name: det_base_v1_qat
description: Model family 'base' text-line detector for still photos: DBNet-lite on MobileNetV4-small 1.0 (32/64/96/128 ch), FPN 64, levels 24, fuse 96, depthwise-separable head (1.18M params, 4.44 G MACs at 960), trained from ImageNet on pages_v2 + pages_v3 at 960, then on pages_v2 / pages_v3o / pages_v5 25/25/50%, then detector QAT; int8 via ESP-PPQ PTQ, .hxhm v2 (raw output), bit-exact with ESP-PPQ (host, wasm SIMD, wasm scalar). Input 960x960 letterbox (long side to 960, top-left, pad 255); output [2,480,480] int8. Reads real photos well without tiles; tiles cost about 1 s more and added false lines in the tests.
tuning: browser pipeline, int8, reading confidence 0.8: see docs/research/JOURNAL.md (2026-11-25, model family) and experiments/family/eval
min_conf_note: page lines whose mean character confidence is below this are hidden as probably not Hunter script (web/test/page_e2e.mjs --conf-sweep)
min_show_score_note: page lines whose detector score (mean text-kernel probability) is below this are hidden too (web/test/page_e2e.mjs --score-sweep)
